--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Isolated copy of bench/leak.luau; the only scenario change is raw checkpoint output.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc024/leak.luau -a jecs|jecs_cleanup|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local name = ({ ... })[1]
local ecs, label = select_build(name)
local UNITS = 500
local ENEMIES = 200
local FRAMES = 5000

local function session(name: string, ecs: any, cleanup_every: number?)
    local world = ecs.world()
    local pair = ecs.pair
    local Health = world:component()
    local Targeting = world:entity()
    local Idle = world:entity()
    local Chasing = world:entity()

    local seed = 777
    local function rand(n: number): number
        seed = seed * 16807 % 2147483647
        return seed % n
    end

    local enemies: { any } = {}
    for i = 1, ENEMIES do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        enemies[i] = e
    end
    local units: { any } = {}
    local targets: { any } = {}
    for i = 1, UNITS do
        local u = world:entity()
        world:set(u, Health, 100)
        world:add(u, Idle)
        units[i] = u
    end

    gc.full()
    local start_kb = gc.kb()
    local t = os.clock()
    local line: { string } = {}
    for frame = 1, FRAMES do
        -- 5 enemies die and 5 new ones spawn every frame
        for _ = 1, 5 do
            local k = rand(ENEMIES) + 1
            world:delete(enemies[k])
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, Health, 100)
            enemies[k] = e
        end
        -- 10 % of the units pick a new target and switch state (jecs does not support
        -- removing a wildcard pair, so the previous target is remembered)
        for _ = 1, UNITS // 10 do
            local k = rand(UNITS) + 1
            local u = units[k]
            local previous = targets[k]
            if previous then
                world:remove(u, pair(Targeting, previous))
            end
            local target = enemies[rand(ENEMIES) + 1]
            world:add(u, pair(Targeting, target))
            targets[k] = target
            if world:has(u, Idle) then
                world:remove(u, Idle)
                world:add(u, Chasing)
            else
                world:remove(u, Chasing)
                world:add(u, Idle)
            end
        end
        -- a system over the chasing units
        local n = 0
        for _u, _health in world:query(Health):with(Chasing) do
            n += 1
        end
        if cleanup_every and frame % cleanup_every == 0 then
            world:cleanup()
        end
        if frame % 1000 == 0 then
            gc.full()
            local kb = gc.kb() - start_kb
            local ms = (os.clock() - t) / 1000 * 1e3
            print(string.format("SESSION\t%d\t%.17g\t%.17g", frame, kb, ms))
            table.insert(line, string.format("%5.0f KB %5.3f ms", kb, ms))
            t = os.clock()
        end
    end
    print(string.format("%-29s %s", name, table.concat(line, " | ")))
end

session(label, ecs, if name == "jecs_cleanup" then 600 else nil)

--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Existing documentation probes: loop heap growth (now GC guarded), deletion hooks, reparenting.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc024/probes.luau -a jecs|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local ecs, label = select_build(({ ... })[1])
local impls: { { any } } = { { label, ecs } }
-- a large heap, so that the loops below finish before the next collection starts
local ballast = table.create(5000000, 0)

local LOOPS = 1000

local function garbage(ecs: any): (number, number, number)
    local world = ecs.world()
    local A, B = world:component(), world:component()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, A, 1)
        world:set(e, B, 2)
    end
    local function inline()
        for _ in world:query(A, B) do
        end
    end
    local stored = world:query(A, B):cached()
    local function loop_stored()
        for _ in stored do
        end
    end
    local function loop_each()
        for _ in world:each(A) do
        end
    end
    local results = {}
    for k, body in { inline, loop_stored, loop_each } do
        body()
        results[k] = gc.allocated(function()
            for _ = 1, LOOPS do
                body()
            end
        end) / LOOPS
    end
    return results[1], results[2], results[3]
end

local N = 10000

local function deletes(ecs: any, hooked: boolean): number
    local best = math.huge
    for _ = 1, 9 do
        local world = ecs.world()
        local A, B, C, D = world:component(), world:component(), world:component(), world:component()
        if hooked then
            world:set(A, ecs.OnRemove, function() end)
        end
        local entities = table.create(N)
        for i = 1, N do
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, A, i)
            world:set(e, B, i)
            world:set(e, C, i)
            world:set(e, D, i)
            entities[i] = e
        end
        gc.full()
        local t = os.clock()
        for i = 1, N do
            world:delete(entities[i])
        end
        best = math.min(best, (os.clock() - t) / N)
    end
    return best
end

print(`garbage per loop of a 2-component query over 200 entities ({LOOPS} loops)`)
for _, impl in impls do
    local inline, stored, each = garbage(impl[2])
    print(string.format("  %-12s inline %.17g B  stored %.17g B  world:each %.17g B", impl[1], inline, stored, each))
end
print(`delete an entity with 4 components, one with an OnRemove hook (min of 9 x {N})`)
for _, impl in impls do
    local plain = deletes(impl[2], false)
    local hooked = deletes(impl[2], true)
    print(
        string.format(
            "  %-12s plain %.17g ns  hooked %.17g ns  hook %.17g ns",
            impl[1],
            plain * 1e9,
            hooked * 1e9,
            (hooked - plain) * 1e9
        )
    )
end
-- 3. a child moved to another parent (an exclusive relation replaces its pair), no monitor
local function moves(ecs: any): number
    local best = math.huge
    for _ = 1, 9 do
        local world = ecs.world()
        local A = world:component()
        local p1, p2 = world:entity(), world:entity()
        local entities = table.create(N)
        for i = 1, N do
            local e = world:entity()
            world:set(e, A, i)
            world:add(e, ecs.pair(ecs.ChildOf, p1))
            entities[i] = e
        end
        gc.full()
        local t = os.clock()
        for i = 1, N do
            world:add(entities[i], ecs.pair(ecs.ChildOf, p2))
        end
        best = math.min(best, (os.clock() - t) / N)
    end
    return best
end

print(`a child moved to another parent, no monitor (min of 9 x {N})`)
for _, impl in impls do
    print(string.format("  %-12s %.17g ns", impl[1], moves(impl[2]) * 1e9))
end
print(#ballast > 0)

--!strict
-- Loads only the selected library for an isolated documentation benchmark.
-- Call with jecs, jecs_cleanup, previous or lib; returns the module and its version label.
return function(name: string): (any, string)
    if name == "jecs" or name == "jecs_cleanup" then
        return require("@jecs"), "jecs 0.11.0"
    elseif name == "previous" then
        local path = "./baseline"
        return (require :: any)(path), "mErCS 0.2.3"
    end
    assert(name == "lib", "unknown build")
    return require("@lib"), "mErCS 0.2.4"
end

--!strict
--!optimize 2
-- Existing wildcard-world retained memory probes, one library per process.
-- Usage: luau -O2 [--codegen] tmp/perf/doc024/wildmem.luau -a jecs|previous|lib
local gc = require("../../../bench/gc")
local select_build = require("./select_build")
local which = ({ ... })[1]
local ecs = select_build(which)
local COUNT = 20000

local function pass(query: any): number
    local total = 0
    for _, _, value in query do
        total += value
    end
    return total
end

local function measure(build: () -> any): number
    gc.full()
    local before = gc.kb()
    local kept = build()
    gc.full()
    local after = gc.kb()
    assert(kept)
    return (after - before) * 1024 / COUNT
end

local star_t: number = measure(function()
    local world = ecs.world()
    local Health = world:component()
    local T = world:entity()
    local relations = {}
    for i = 1, 32 do
        relations[i] = world:component()
    end
    for i = 1, COUNT do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        world:set(e, ecs.pair(relations[i % 32 + 1], T), i)
    end
    local query = world:query(Health, ecs.pair(ecs.Wildcard, T)):cached()
    assert(pass(query) > 0)
    return { world, query }
end)

local r_star: number = measure(function()
    local world = ecs.world()
    local Health = world:component()
    local Damage = world:component()
    local targets = {}
    for i = 1, 8 do
        targets[i] = world:entity()
    end
    for i = 1, COUNT do
        local e = world:entity()
        world:set(e, Health, 100)
        world:set(e, ecs.pair(Damage, targets[i % 8 + 1]), i)
    end
    local query = world:query(Health, ecs.pair(Damage, ecs.Wildcard)):cached()
    assert(pass(query) > 0)
    return { world, query }
end)

print(string.format("WILDMEM\t%.17g\t%.17g", star_t :: number, r_star :: number))

"""Measure the existing comparison scenarios in isolated processes, five times per mode.

All wrapper sources and commands are embedded in the output for reproduction.
Run from the repository root: python -B tmp/perf/doc024/run.py
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LUAU = Path('C:/Users/usr/.rokit/tool-storage/luau-lang/luau/0.740.0/luau.exe')
BUILDS = ('jecs', 'previous', 'lib')
RUNS = 5

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def parse(profile, output):
    rows = []
    skipped = []
    def add(group, name, metric, unit, value):
        value = float(value)
        assert math.isfinite(value), (profile, group, name, value)
        rows.append([group, name, metric, unit, value])
    for line in output.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('SAMPLE\t'):
            _, group, name, unit, seconds, memory = line.split('\t')
            add(group, name, 'time', 's/' + unit, seconds)
            if memory != '-':
                add(group, name, 'retained', 'bytes/' + unit, memory)
        elif line.startswith('SKIP\t'):
            skipped.append(line.split('\t')[1:])
        elif line.startswith('FRAME\t'):
            _, name, best, median = line.split('\t')
            add('frame', name, 'minimum', 's/frame', best)
            add('frame', name, 'median', 's/frame', median)
        elif line.startswith('SESSION\t'):
            _, frame, kb, ms = line.split('\t')
            add('session', frame, 'heap growth', 'MiB', float(kb) / 1024)
            add('session', frame, 'time', 's/frame', float(ms) / 1000)
        elif line.startswith('WILDMEM\t'):
            _, star_t, r_star = line.split('\t')
            add('wildcard world', '(*, T)', 'retained', 'bytes/entity', star_t)
            add('wildcard world', '(R, *)', 'retained', 'bytes/entity', r_star)
        elif match := re.search(r'inline ([\d.e+-]+) B  stored ([\d.e+-]+) B  world:each ([\d.e+-]+) B', line):
            for name, value in zip(('inline query', 'stored query', 'world:each'), match.groups()):
                add('loop heap growth', name, 'heap growth', 'bytes/loop', value)
        elif match := re.search(r'plain ([\d.e+-]+) ns  hooked ([\d.e+-]+) ns  hook ([\d.e+-]+) ns', line):
            for name, value in zip(('plain delete', 'hooked delete', 'hook overhead'), match.groups()):
                add('hooks', name, 'time', 's/entity', float(value) * 1e-9)
        elif profile == 'probes' and (match := re.fullmatch(r'\s+(?:jecs 0\.11\.0|mErCS 0\.2\.[34])\s+([\d.e+-]+) ns', line)):
            add('hooks', 'move child without monitor', 'time', 's/child', float(match.group(1)) * 1e-9)
    assert rows, (profile, output)
    assert len({tuple(row[:4]) for row in rows}) == len(rows)
    if profile != 'matrix':
        assert len(rows) == {'frame': 4, 'leak': 10, 'probes': 7, 'wildmem': 2}[profile]
    return rows, skipped

baseline = OUT / 'baseline/init.luau'
baseline.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
baseline.write_bytes(subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'v0.2.3:src/init.luau'], cwd=ROOT,
                                    check=True, capture_output=True).stdout)
paths = list((ROOT / 'bench').glob('*.luau')) + list(OUT.glob('*.luau')) + [
    ROOT / 'src/init.luau', baseline,
    ROOT / 'DevPackages/_Index/ukendio_jecs@0.11.0/jecs/src/jecs.luau',
    ROOT / 'DevPackages/_Index/ukendio_jecs@0.11.0/jecs/modules/OB/module.luau',
]
hashes = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\', '/'): sha(path) for path in paths}
data = {
    'date': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), 'started': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
    'environment': f'{platform.platform()} / {platform.processor()}',
    'luau': 'luau-lang/luau@0.740.0', 'luau_sha256': sha(LUAU),
    'versions': {'jecs': 'jecs 0.11.0', 'jecs_cleanup': 'jecs 0.11.0 + cleanup / 600',
                 'previous': 'mErCS 0.2.3', 'lib': 'mErCS 0.2.4'},
    'baseline_commit': subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'v0.2.3^{commit}'], cwd=ROOT,
                                      check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(),
    'sha256': hashes, 'runs': RUNS, 'complete': False, 'samples': [],
    'entrypoints': {path.name: path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for path in OUT.glob('*.luau')},
    'runner': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
}
destination = OUT / 'samples.json'
started = time.monotonic()
expected = {}
for mode in ('interpreter', 'native'):
    for repeat in range(RUNS):
        for profile in ('matrix', 'frame', 'leak', 'probes', 'wildmem'):
            builds = BUILDS + ('jecs_cleanup',) if profile == 'leak' else BUILDS
            order = builds[repeat % len(builds):] + builds[:repeat % len(builds)]
            for build in order:
                command = [str(LUAU), '-O2'] + (['--codegen'] if mode == 'native' else [])
                command += [f'tmp/perf/doc024/{profile}.luau', '-a', build]
                print(f'Start {mode} {repeat + 1}/{RUNS} {profile} {build}', flush=True)
                result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, encoding='utf-8')
                output = result.stdout + result.stderr
                log = OUT / f'{profile}-{mode}-{build}-{repeat + 1}.log'
                log.write_text(output, encoding='utf-8')
                if result.returncode:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'{log}: exit {result.returncode}\n{output}')
                rows, skipped = parse(profile, result.stdout)
                key = (profile, build)
                layout = {tuple(row[:4]) for row in rows}
                if key in expected:
                    assert layout == expected[key], key
                expected[key] = layout
                data['samples'].append({'mode': mode, 'repeat': repeat + 1, 'profile': profile,
                                        'build': build, 'command': command[1:], 'rows': rows,
                                        'skipped': skipped, 'output': output})
                destination.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
                print(f'Done: {len(data["samples"])} processes, {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s', flush=True)

for filename, expected_hash in hashes.items():
    assert sha(ROOT / filename) == expected_hash, f'Changed during measurement: {filename}'
data['complete'] = True
data['elapsed_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
destination.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('All comparison measurements complete', flush=True)
